mapper.select: SELECT id, row_version, created_at, updated_at, chapter_id, tension_curve_json::text AS tension_curve_json, open_questions_json::text AS open_questions_json, resolved_questions_json::text AS resolved_questions_json, pacing_warnings_json::text AS pacing_warnings_json FROM retention_maps WHERE chapter_id = #{chapterId}

SELECT id, row_version, created_at, updated_at, chapter_id, tension_curve_json::text AS tension_curve_json, open_questions_json::text AS open_questions_json, resolved_questions_json::text AS resolved_questions_json, pacing_warnings_json::text AS pacing_warnings_json FROM retention_maps WHERE id = #{id}

INSERT INTO retention_maps (row_version, created_at, updated_at, chapter_id, tension_curve_json, open_questions_json, resolved_questions_json, pacing_warnings_json) VALUES (#{rowVersion}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), COALESCE(#{updatedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), #{chapterId}, COALESCE(#{tensionCurveJson}::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb), COALESCE(#{openQuestionsJson}::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb), COALESCE(#{resolvedQuestionsJson}::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb), COALESCE(#{pacingWarningsJson}::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb)) RETURNING id
mapper.update: UPDATE retention_maps SET tension_curve_json = COALESCE(#{tensionCurveJson}::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb), open_questions_json = COALESCE(#{openQuestionsJson}::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb), resolved_questions_json = COALESCE(#{resolvedQuestionsJson}::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb), pacing_warnings_json = COALESCE(#{pacingWarningsJson}::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb), updated_at = #{updatedAt}, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND row_version = #{rowVersion}
